articles.title: Apple Maps changes Lake Ontario to Lake America after Trump order - BBC
articles.description: The iPhone maker follows rival technology giant Google in relabelling the Great Lake.
articles.content: "Just in case President Trump or anyone else forgets, we've set up this sign to remind them, it's Lake Ontario, now and forever," Ontario Premier Doug Ford said.
